audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart said Riven owns Levels 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items, and that Graves owns Level 1. That contradicts both the packet chart (Riven, Graves, Graves, Graves, Graves, Graves, Skill), the 54.29% Graves win rate, and the content-layer whys/spikes text on the same page, which describes Graves winning every stage from 2 onward.
audit.why: Riven's Broken Wings (13s, 275 range) plus Valor (10/9/8/7/6s) let her step in and out at level 1 while Graves has one ability, no Quickdraw and a shell spread that only bites point-blank. From level 2-3 Graves has Quickdraw (16/15/14/13/12s, refunded by autos) and Smoke Screen, and the True Grit resist stacking makes her short trades unprofitable; late, crit-scaling and Riven's flank pattern make it skill-dependent.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Riven / Graves / Graves / Graves / Graves / Graves / Skill in both layers, with matching ratings.

audit.why: Spike structure is right: Riven level 1, Graves levels 2-3 (Quickdraw + Smoke Screen), Graves level 6 (Collateral Damage), Riven's Eclipse first item as her flip window. Four spikes present, no structural gap.
audit.corrected: Kept, with Riven's ability names inserted and Blade of the Exile's 120/90/60 pattern respected — her all-in window is her ult plus Eclipse, not her ult alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never named a single Riven ability (Runic Blade, Broken Wings, Ki Burst, Valor, Blade of the Exile), called the stun a 'three-Q stun' when the stun is Ki Burst (W, 11/10/9/8/7s) and the third Broken Wings cast is a knockback, and called Graves' E 'Bushwhack-dash' when it is Quickdraw.
audit.why: Riven's kit per Riot text: Q Broken Wings, 13s, 275 range, three casts, third knocks back. W Ki Burst, 11/10/9/8/7s, 260 range, the only stun. E Valor, 10/9/8/7/6s, 250 range, dash plus damage-blocking shield. R Blade of the Exile, 120/90/60s, grants bonus AD and range plus one Wind Slash. Graves' E is Quickdraw and its cooldown is lowered by landing basic attacks, which is why holding it into her engage is correct.
audit.corrected: Real names used; the stun attributed to Ki Burst with its rank-1 11s cooldown; the third Broken Wings cast described as a knockback; Valor named as the shield that eats one shell rather than the magazine.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riven is referred to as 'he/his' in several full-layer fields.
audit.why: Riven is female; the page mixes pronouns between layers.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tldr, report[0].t, tradeBad, dontsFull[2].d and ahead.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Land Collateral Damage' in wants.you[2]. Collateral Damage is Graves' real R name — false positive, left alone.

notes: Level chart was contradicting itself: the full/content sides said Riven owned levels 3 through 2+ items while the whys and spikes on the same page described Graves winning those stages, and the packet chart agrees with the text, not the sides. All seven rows proposed as full/content pairs in one atomic group. suspectNames hit on 'Land Collateral Damage' is a false positive — that is Graves' real ultimate. Not verified from the kits and therefore left alone: whether Graves' Quickdraw dash can be used during Riven's third-Broken-Wings knockback airborne window (the timing claim in whys[3] and spikes[3] about dashing 'through' the knockup), and whether Smoke Screen's sight reduction actually blinds Riven's autos rather than only cutting vision — the existing text asserts a blind, which Riot's W description does not state. Both are recorded in unverified rather than rewritten.
